Keeping peptides cool in Surprise

Climate figures here come from NOAA's Youngtown station, about 10 miles east-southeast of Surprise's Census center point.94 Its 1991 to 2020 normals put the June to August average high at 103.5 °F, with 115.3 days a year reaching 100 °F or more.10 Summer nights run cooler than in central Phoenix: the July low averages 79.7 °F at Youngtown against 84.5 °F at Phoenix Sky Harbor.911 Winters are mild: January averages 65.4 °F by day and 41.1 °F at night, and only 3.9 nights a year fall to 32 °F or below.910

Bring a delivered parcel indoors promptly, but the larger change in storage comes later, when a vial is mixed. GenScript says peptides keep for a far shorter time once dissolved than as freeze-dried powder.12 Because dissolved peptides are also open to breakdown by bacteria, GenScript advises against keeping them in solution.12 Hospira's labels for its two waters say much the same about their own use: mix thoroughly, use promptly, and do not store a reconstituted solution unless the maker of the dissolved drug directs otherwise.1314

The choice of water matters too. Bacteriostatic Water for Injection contains 0.9 percent or 1.1 percent benzyl alcohol as a preservative and comes in a multiple-dose container.13 Sterile Water for Injection has no preservative and comes only in single-dose containers.1314 For an opened multiple-dose vial, CDC injection safety guidance for clinicians says to date it and discard it within 28 days, unless the manufacturer gives another date.15 The storage guide lays out refrigerator and freezer storage for both powder and solution.

About Surprise

The local paper, the Surprise Independent, calls Flora Statler the founder of Surprise.16 It says she died at 63, received full credit for founding the city only decades later, and is also credited with starting El Mirage and Yarnell.16 The same 2022 column recalls that when Sun City Grand opened for buyers, its developers expected about 20,000 people to live there within a decade, double Surprise's population of nearly 15,000 at the time.16

The Census Bureau's July 2025 estimate is 175,304, about 22 percent above the April 2020 base of 143,150 and 4.6 percent above the 2024 figure of 167,602.1 The city covers 110.51 square miles of land.4

Surprise Stadium, also known as Billy Parker Field, is the shared spring training home of the Texas Rangers and the Kansas City Royals, and the Rangers have trained in Surprise every spring since 2003.2 The Rangers open their 2027 Cactus League schedule there on Friday, February 19, against the Royals, and 15 of their 29 Cactus League games are set for Surprise.2 The Royals' 2026 schedule opened their 24th Cactus League season at the stadium on February 20, with 15 home games there.17

The city skews older than the county. The 2024 American Community Survey puts its median age at 43.4, against 38.0 for Maricopa County, with 21.4 percent of residents 65 or older and 18.8 percent under 18.182319 Veterans make up 11.0 percent of civilian adults.2019

Banner Health Center Surprise, a Banner primary care site in the city, sits just over 3 miles from Banner Del E. Webb Medical Center in neighboring Sun City West.21 The hospital has been open for more than 35 years and has room to add 92 beds, which would bring the campus to nearly 500.21 Both are training sites for the Del E. Webb internal medicine residency run by the University of Arizona's College of Medicine Phoenix, which names orthopedics, robotic surgery, cardiac services, and women's health and maternity among the hospital's specialties.21 Federal Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services data list Banner Del E. Webb and Banner Boswell Medical Center, in Sun City, as nonprofit acute care hospitals with emergency services.22 The same data list two psychiatric hospitals with Surprise addresses, Destiny Springs Healthcare and Avenir Behavioral Health Center, neither with emergency services.22

Frequently asked questions

Can I order research peptides for delivery in Surprise?

Yes. Orders to Surprise ship from the USA and Canada under the shipping policy that covers every order across the United States, and the whole city lies in Maricopa County.1 ZIP Code Tabulation Areas 85374 and 85379 sit entirely inside the city, and most of 85388, 85378 and 85387 does too.3 Each product page lists its strengths and stock status, so both can be checked before checkout.

Do Sun City West and Sun City get the same service?

Yes. Neither has a page of its own, but addresses there are handled like any other. The Census Gazetteer lists both as census-designated places rather than incorporated cities.4 Sun City West's center point is about 5.5 miles from Surprise's, and Sun City's about 10.5 miles.4 For those addresses, this page and the Peoria page cover the surrounding area.

How long can a lab in Surprise keep a mixed research vial?

Not long, as a rule. Bachem advises against storing peptides in solution, because they slowly break down even when sterile, and says frozen solutions may keep for a few weeks.5 Labels for approved products show how widely the limits vary: EGRIFTA SV is used right away, EGRIFTA WR within 7 days at room temperature, and ZOMACTON within 14 or 28 days in a refrigerator, depending on the vial.678 The reconstitution guide covers lab practice.
